titulo: Vivek Ramaswamy stands by ad featuring Amy Acton's mother despite bipartisan criticism in Ohio
cuerpo: Biotech billionaire Vivek Ramaswamy embarked on a statewide bus tour across Ohio with fellow Republicans on Friday, even as his gubernatorial campaign's ad featuring the estranged mother of Democratic rival Amy Acton was sowing growing divisions within his party as they fight to maintain political control of the state.
